Dorian visited and said a new lock was needed (event-020). The tenant says he is due today after 10:00 (event-023). No attendance or repair is confirmed yet, so this is not a completion and we cannot close it. The tenant replied after our last message (event-022) and said she will update us, so we are not overdue on anyone and a chase would be wrong. Escalation is not needed now. The door can still be locked by hand per event-001, and no one has reported that it cannot be secured, so P0 and P1 do not apply. Priority is P2 because security is a concern and a visit is due today. The decision would change if the tenant reports the door cannot be secured (P0/P1) or the visit does not happen. In that case the next step is to ask for the outcome or escalate to a person to reassign. I did not contact Dorian because no direct contact details for him are in the case. The landlord's earlier complaint about coordination (event-011) was already answered in event-015.
